# Text script functions

Functions for C# (`Cb.Call`) and Python (a `cb` method each, or `cb.call`). See [Script functions](index.md) for how to use them.

![A Run Python code step in the action editor](../../assets/screens/actions-python-step.png)

## text.resolve

Fills in the variables in a text, just like a sub-action does: %variables%, ~globals~ and $functions()$.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `text` | The text with placeholders, like "Thanks %user%, you are follower number ~followers~!". |

**Gives back:** The text with every placeholder filled in.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("text.resolve", new { text = "Thanks %user% for the follow!" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.text_resolve(text="Thanks %user% for the follow!")
    ```
